gloss: setting sail; departure by ship; a new start

definitions.gloss: setting sail; putting out to sea
definitions.explanation: A ship's departure from harbor, seen from the moment it leaves. Slightly literary; everyday announcements use {出港|しゅっこう} or {出発|しゅっぱつ}.

definitions.gloss: a new start; the launch of a venture
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, the beginning of a new stage of life or of an organization, with the sense that the journey ahead is uncertain. Common in speeches, headlines, and congratulatory messages.

notes:
⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧ + ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧, with the compound reading ふな⟦で→で：00502_de⟧. Used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船出|ふなで}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set sail; to make a fresh start
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{船出|ふなで}: a new beginning
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{船出|ふなで}: the start of a new chapter in life
- {船出|ふなで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧: to celebrate someone's new start

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出港|しゅっこう}→出港：11764_shukkou⟧: departure from port — the plain factual term used in schedules and news
- ⟦{門出|かどで}→門出：15268_kadode⟧: setting out — the same congratulatory use, without the nautical image
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧: departure — the general word for any kind of setting off
